title: False 30-minute break violations after fuel-then-meal stops
text: Safety is getting false 30-minute break violations on the Hartline dedicated fleet, and two drivers have escalated to their terminal manager. Driver 2217's log for 10/05 starts at 06:00 with 7h driving, then a 15-minute fuel stop (on duty), a 20-minute meal (off duty) right after it, then 3h more driving. That is a valid break under the 2020 rule, but we flag a violation at 14:35. The report comes from `break_violations` in `hos_breaks.py`.
